checks.subject: Complete active sets
checks.finding: nonsimpleActiveSet is the finite set of all original equalities. mem_exactStratum_iff_activeSet proves exact equality with that complete set, and every feasible point belongs to its own exact stratum.

checks.subject: Actual closed sets and uniqueness
checks.finding: nonsimpleClosedFace is the original closed halfspace intersection plus the selected equalities. Antitonicity and subset/equality characterizations use nonempty exact strata; two nonempty complete-active strata cannot index the same actual closed subset.

checks.subject: Finite normal-rank face/incidence indices
checks.finding: NonsimpleFaceIndex retains the entire finite active set, a genuine nonempty exact stratum, and the finrank of its actual span. Its index and incidences are finite. Incidence inclusion is the reverse inclusion of the actual closed faces, rather than a chosen triple encoding.

checks.subject: Actual representative levels and strictness
checks.finding: The chosen representative comes from stratum nonemptiness. Every active supporting level is exact, every inactive original inequality is strict, and its complete active set is proved equal to the stored set.

checks.subject: Strict polar derived from interior
checks.finding: The strict polar direction is an actual strict interior point minus the actual representative. It pairs strictly negatively with every active original normal; no separating-vector or cone-identity conclusion is supplied as a premise.

checks.subject: Original-facet pair and triple independence
checks.finding: Pair and triple linear independence are derived from the existing strict interior and genuine deleted-inequality witnesses via actualFacet affine inconsistency. Unit norms exclude zero generators. No generic-threshold or pre-assumed linear-independence hypothesis is used.

checks.subject: Rank-two ridges
checks.finding: If a nonempty complete active set has normal rank at most two then it has at most two members, since any three active normals are linearly independent. Rank<=card gives exactly two at rank two. The exported pair witness satisfies both exact levels and all other original inequalities strictly.

checks.subject: Rank-three nonsimple faces
checks.finding: Every three distinct selected active original normals span the rank-three active normal space, and a spanning triple is constructed from the actual finite active set. No cardinality-three assertion is made about that active set; more than three active facets remain allowed.

checks.subject: Supporting-pair strictness
checks.finding: For a nonzero normal n in the actual rank-three space, nonnegative pairing with all active generators and zero pairing with two distinct ones imply strict positive pairing with every other active generator. A hypothetical third zero would annihilate a spanning independent triple, hence n itself.

checks.subject: Local feasible rays
checks.finding: The tangent inequalities on active constraints and genuine strict gaps at every inactive constraint yield a common positive small step by finite continuity. The actual point x+t*y satisfies every original halfspace.

checks.subject: Genuine outward cone equality
checks.finding: The outward inequality at that constructed feasible ray gives the polar inequalities. The already proved finite strict-polar cone theorem identifies the actual full nonnegative generated cone. The reverse implication is the actual halfspace-sum outward argument.

checks.subject: Exact-presentation transport
checks.finding: At the same physical base point, equal actual polyhedra with strict interiors have equal actual outward normal cones, hence equal full active generated cones and active normal spans. Expanded polyhedra are never identified.

checks.subject: Singleton positive multiple
checks.finding: When the exact active set in the selected presentation is a singleton, every original active normal lies on its nonnegative ray. Strict interior excludes zero original active normals, making the multiplier strictly positive; common supporting levels prove the exact offset scaling with the same multiplier.

checks.subject: Genuine Cone dependency
checks.finding: The separately audited 13-target Cone module proves coefficient bounds from a strict polar direction, compact finite coefficient subsequences for closedness, and actual hyperplane separation/Farkas polarity. It does not assume the desired outward-normal identity.

checks.subject: Audit/type/supplier boundary
checks.finding: All44 source-declared public definitions, theorems, abbreviations and named instances were included. Build plus all three forced source elaborations passed; strict44 axiom audit and fresh pp.all44 types/85-node project graph passed. Cofaces is absent from source import closure and kernel graph.

ordinary_geometric_inputs: A finite original halfspace family and a nonempty complete exact stratum for the indexed face.
Strict interior of the actual halfspace intersection for the genuine normal-cone/Farkas and positivity statements.
For pair/triple independence and exact rank-two ridge classification: genuine irredundant deleted-inequality witnesses and unit original normals.
For the supporting-pair strictness lemma: an actual nonzero supporting direction in the rank-three normal span with nonnegative pairing and two specified zero generators.
For exact-presentation transport: equality of the actual physical polyhedra, exact strata at the same base point and strict interior for each presentation.
not_assumed: A face/ridge surface bound, Gaussian probability bound, Green formula, conormal/incidence identity or arbitrary nonsimple spherical balance.
Simplicity or a cardinality-three active set at rank three.
Equality of the positive cone of the complete active family with the cone of a selected spanning triple.
Generic thresholds, volume-almost-every qualifications or target normal-cone equality.
not_proved_in_this_packet: Coface construction/incidence enumeration under development in SupplementalHNonsimpleFaceCofaces.lean.
A library affine-codimension/relative-interior or Hausdorff-normalization identification; rank is explicitly finrank of the actual active normal span.
A complete all-threshold nonsimple Green identity, nonsimple face integral/coarea transport, arbitrary spherical-polygon grouping or a new final surface/CLT inequality.
